ezekiel.15.p1.b1.text: Son of man, how does the wood of the vine surpass any other branch among the trees in the forest? … Or can one make from it a peg on which to hang utensils?

ezekiel.15.p1.b2.text: No, it is cast into the fire for fuel. The fire devours both ends, and the middle is charred. Can it be useful for anything?

ezekiel.15.p1.b3.text: Like the wood of the vine among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so I will give up the people of Jerusalem.

ezekiel.15.p1.b4.text: Thus I will make the land desolate, because they have acted unfaithfully,’ declares the Lord GOD.
